CustomField.label: Fixkosten (Teile + Spesen + Zusathre)
CustomField.description: SCRUM-464: roughly what fixing the third-party product cost us - ONE figure covering parts, travel and extra hours together (PO decision, not three numbers). Org default currency, no per-record currency. Blank when nobody knows: unknown cost counts in the case count, never in total or average, and is shown as "cost not known", not 0.
